expectations.text: Each brief has a narrow scope (one test file and the code it covers), a clear done-criterion (that test file passes) and the expected output format
expectations.evidence: Each brief says "Your job is only `auth.test.js`" (and the same for cart and search), gives the goal "get every test in `auth.test.js` to pass", and has a "Report back (under 200 words)" section with set bullet items.

expectations.text: The briefs tell each subagent what it must not change (other areas or the tests' assertions) and to report what it changed and why
expectations.evidence: Each brief's constraints say "Do not delete, skip (`.skip`, `xit`), or weaken assertions" and "Do not edit `cart.test.js` or `search.test.js`", and the report asks for "Each failing test, its root cause, and the fix" and "Files you changed".
